name: 갈기 셋째 마루 · 저승길 차림
quote: 무너진 낙원의 잔상 속에서, 깨지 않는 꿈을 베어낸다.
face: 강렬한 황금빛 눈동자를 지닌 무표정한 얼굴
hair: 먼지 묻은 듯한 베이지색 갈색 머리카락
wings: 깃털 대신 부유하는 황금빛 빛의 파편들
outfit: 낡은 갈색 가죽 닌자복과 찢어진 성스러운 천 조각
gloves: 금속 장식이 달린 갈색 가죽 건틀릿
shoes: 발목을 감싸는 낡은 짚신 형태의 부츠
accessories: 머리 뒤에 떠 있는 거대한 황금빛 후광
silhouette: 머리 뒤의 거대한 원형 후광, 어깨 위로 떠 있는 빛의 파편들, 길게 뻗은 단검의 날카로운 선, 짐승의 귀 실루엣
signature_motion: 공중에서 회전하며 빛의 잔상을 남기는 참격
signature_vfx: 몽환적인 황금빛 입자가 흩날리는 잔상 효과
visual_en: A small-scale divine ninja with lion-like ears and dusty beige hair. A massive golden halo floats behind the head. Shards of golden light drift around the shoulders. Wearing weathered brown leather ninja attire with tattered beige cloth. The eyes glow with intense golden light. A golden dagger is held in hand, leaving a trail of light. The overall color is dominated by earthy browns and rich divine gold.
features_en: Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing in a low, focused ninja stance, ready to dash through a dream.
vfx_en: Swirling golden particles and hazy, dream-like light trails.

derive.prompt: Keep this exact same character: the same face, head, hair, body shape, size, pose and skin, and the same hands holding the same weapon in the same place. Change only the clothing and accessories to an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality. Keep the body colors readable on both dark stone and light grey floors (not all black, not all white). Full body, three-quarter view facing right.
